text_block_list.text:
One day, near the school gate, I spotted 
Jungle Pocket being confronted by a horse 
girl from outside the academy.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl in Tokkofuku
text_block_list.text:
J... Jungle Pocket-san! Why did you quit 
running free-style races?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? The hell's your deal all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl in Tokkofuku
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, I saw you run, 
Pokke-san, and I admired you so much! I 
finally managed to join your team!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl in Tokkofuku
text_block_list.text:
But right when I joined, you were already 
gone, Pokke-san... Why...?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Saw my running, huh.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl in Tokkofuku
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I thought I'd get to run 
together with you on your team...! Please! 
Come back to the team!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, I see.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: So for you, that person happened to be me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fine, come with me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, and you over there. You were at 
that tea party too, right? If you're 
worried, tag along. Consider yourself the 
chaperone.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A karaoke box is always the best choice! 
Big screen, and you can blast the volume 
as loud as ya want.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl in Tokkofuku
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, what? Um, what is this?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Just shut up and watch.

Saying that, Jungle Pocket used the 
karaoke monitor to play a recording of a 
race.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji Kiseki! Fuji Kiseki breaks away! The 
chasers are closing in, but she won't 
yield!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji Kiseki dazzles the crowd with her 
brilliant running! The entire venue is 
swept up in a frenzy!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —This race changed my life.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was chasing "the strongest" 
title and spending every waking moment in 
free races, I had a sudden whim.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —The Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was raving about it, so I figured 
I'd go check out what these well-mannered 
races were all about.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't had that whim and gone to 
watch with my pals— I never would've 
witnessed that run.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki dazzles the crowd with her 
brilliant running! The entire venue is 
swept up in a frenzy!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...It was "overwhelming."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just when I thought it was over, she 
kicked into another gear in the final 
stretch, pulling away from the rest—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nobody could've seen that coming. To put 
on a show that incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—I wanna run. I wanna run like that too!! 
That was the only damn thing left in my 
head!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—I rewatched this video over and over 
again, and before I knew it, I wound up 
here at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl in Tokkofuku
text_block_list.text:
...Pokke-san, you were struck by the exact 
same shock as me...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl in Tokkofuku
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm so sorry! Saying you should come 
back to the team without understanding 
anything!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmph, then keep your eyes peeled.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Watch me become the "strongest" in the 
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Course not, it's my dream. Besides, since 
she looks up to me, she wants to see it 
too, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: My back, as the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl in Tokkofuku
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, well... of course!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, then come see it in person! My 
all-out brawl, the ultimate race!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Watch me become the "strongest" in the 
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Right, no time to waste sitting 
around.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Gonna go run! You're coming too, right?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl in Tokkofuku
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah... P-Please wait up—?!

Jungle Pocket took off with a refreshing 
stride. I found myself wanting to go see 
her race with my own eyes.
